# Studio Soulutions

> Studio Soulutions makes every studio in a salon-suite building discoverable: a mobile web app for visitors and tenants, an optional lobby kiosk, and a self-serve portal for studio owners, all white-labeled to the building's own brand. Built and run by Hive-Rise in Surprise, Arizona.

Salon-suite buildings hold dozens of independent studios behind one front door, and a walk-in has no way to know who is inside. Studio Soulutions gives the building one link: a directory app with every studio's card, services, hours, booking links and an interactive suite map. Studio owners keep their own cards current through a code-protected portal, and the building owner approves every change before it goes live.

## Pages

- [Home](https://studiosoulutions.com/): what the product is and who it is for
- [Salon Plus Studios directory](https://studiosoulutions.com/salonplus/): the first live building, in Surprise, Arizona
- [Join a directory](https://studiosoulutions.com/join/): how a studio gets its card

## Facts

- The product is sold to salon-suite building owners; each building gets its own fully branded app.
- Visitors install nothing: the app is a web app, installable from the browser on request.
- Contact and sales run through Hive-Rise (hive-rise.com), the agency behind the product.
